```cpp
// =========================================================================
// set_string_value (string length change, implicit detach)
// =========================================================================

TEST_CASE("set_string_value Case A grows a non-overflow entry", "[patcher]") {
    auto f = hbc::HBCFile::open(HBC_CORPUS_DIR "/hello.hbc");
    const auto h0 = f.header();
    const std::string newVal = "strict mode enabled";  // 20 B, was "use strict" (10 B)

    auto m = hbc::Module::from(f);
    m.set_string_value(4, newVal);
    auto g = reparse(m.serialize());
    const auto h1 = g.header();

    REQUIRE(h1.stringStorageSize  == h0.stringStorageSize + newVal.size());
    REQUIRE(h1.stringCount        == h0.stringCount);
    REQUIRE(h1.stringKindCount    == h0.stringKindCount);
    REQUIRE(h1.overflowStringCount == h0.overflowStringCount);
    REQUIRE(g.strings().at(4) == newVal);
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < h0.stringCount; ++i)
        if (i != 4) REQUIRE(g.strings()[i] == f.strings()[i]);
    requireAllFunctionsUnchanged(f, g);
}

TEST_CASE("set_string_value Case A shrinks a non-overflow entry", "[patcher]") {
    auto f = hbc::HBCFile::open(HBC_CORPUS_DIR "/hello.hbc");
    const auto h0 = f.header();

    uint32_t storageStart = 0;
    for (const auto& s : f.section_map())
        if (s.name == "string storage") storageStart = s.offset;
    REQUIRE(storageStart != 0);

    auto m = hbc::Module::from(f);
    m.set_string_value(4, "ok");  // 2 B, was "use strict" (10 B)
    auto g = reparse(m.serialize());

    REQUIRE(g.header().stringStorageSize == h0.stringStorageSize + 2);
    REQUIRE(g.strings().at(4) == "ok");
    // Append-only: the new offset is past the end of the ORIGINAL storage
    // (never an in-place reuse of the old slot).
    REQUIRE(g.string_entries().at(4).storageOffset >= storageStart + h0.stringStorageSize);
}

TEST_CASE("set_string_value Case B rejects promotion to overflow", "[patcher]") {
    auto f = hbc::HBCFile::open(HBC_CORPUS_DIR "/hello.hbc");
    REQUIRE_FALSE(f.string_entries().at(4).isOverflow);   // "use strict", non-overflow
    auto m = hbc::Module::from(f);
    REQUIRE_THROWS_WITH(m.set_string_value(4, std::string(300, 'x')),
                        Catch::Matchers::ContainsSubstring("overflow"));
}

    m.set_string_value(3, "abc");

TEST_CASE("set_string_value Case C keeps an already-overflow entry overflow (real bundle)", "[patcher]") {
    auto f = openOrSkip(HBC_CORPUS_DIR "/ridemovi.hbc");
    const auto& entries0 = f.string_entries();
    REQUIRE(entries0.at(328).isOverflow);   // finding: CSS blob, 458 characters
    const uint32_t ovfCount0 = f.header().overflowStringCount;

    auto m = hbc::Module::from(f);
    m.set_string_value(328, "short css");   // 9 B, much shorter
    auto g = reparse(m.serialize());

    REQUIRE(g.header().overflowStringCount == ovfCount0);   // no slot change
    REQUIRE(g.string_entries().at(328).isOverflow);          // stays overflow (never demoted)
    REQUIRE(g.strings().at(328) == "short css");
    // the other overflow entries (including the remaining 646) are untouched.
    const auto& entries1 = g.string_entries();
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < entries0.size(); ++i) {
        if (i == 328 || !entries0[i].isOverflow) continue;
        REQUIRE(entries1[i].storageOffset == entries0[i].storageOffset);
        REQUIRE(g.strings()[i] == f.strings()[i]);
    }
}

TEST_CASE("set_string_value Case A supports a real UTF-16 entry (real bundle)", "[patcher]") {
    auto f = openOrSkip(HBC_CORPUS_DIR "/ridemovi.hbc");
    const auto& e = f.string_entries().at(22928);
    REQUIRE(e.isUTF16);
    REQUIRE_FALSE(e.isOverflow);

    // "nouveau texte utf16" in UTF-16LE (BMP only, ASCII characters for simplicity).
    std::string newBytes;
    for (char c : std::string("nouveau texte utf16")) {
        newBytes.push_back(c);
        newBytes.push_back('\0');
    }
    auto m = hbc::Module::from(f);
    m.set_string_value(22928, newBytes);
    auto g = reparse(m.serialize());

    const auto& e1 = g.string_entries().at(22928);
    REQUIRE(e1.isUTF16);
    REQUIRE(e1.byteLength == newBytes.size());
    REQUIRE(g.strings().at(22928) == "nouveau texte utf16");
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// set_literal_value: generalized value-edit + silent detach
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

TEST_CASE("set_literal_value grows the array buffer and repoints only the target site", "[patcher]") {
    auto f = openOrSkip(HBC_CORPUS_DIR "/literals_g0.hbc");
    const auto& sites = f.literal_sites();
    if (sites.size() != 1 || sites[0].isObject)
        SKIP("literals_g0.hbc: unexpected compiler layout");
    const auto site = sites[0];
    const auto h0 = f.header();
    const auto oldBuf = f.array_buffer();

    // [10,20,30] (Integer,Integer,Integer) -> [10,Null,30]: element 1
    // changes TAG (Integer -> Null, 0 value bytes) - RLE recomputed by
    // hand (no run can merge, the tag changes in the middle):
    //   Integer run=1 (10) | Null run=1 | Integer run=1 (30)
    static const uint8_t kNewPayload[] = {
        0x71, 0x0a, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00,
        0x01,
        0x71, 0x1e, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00,
    };
    const std::string newBytes(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(kNewPayload), sizeof(kNewPayload));

    auto m = hbc::Module::from(f);
    m.set_literal_value(site.functionIndex, site.instructionOffset, site.isObject, newBytes);
    auto g = reparse(m.serialize());

    REQUIRE(g.header().arrayBufferSize == h0.arrayBufferSize + newBytes.size());
    const auto newBuf = g.array_buffer();
    REQUIRE(newBuf.substr(0, oldBuf.size()) == oldBuf);    // append-only: prefix intact
    REQUIRE(newBuf.substr(oldBuf.size())    == newBytes);

    const auto& sites1 = g.literal_sites();
    REQUIRE(sites1.size() == 1);
    REQUIRE(sites1[0].bufferIdx == static_cast<uint32_t>(oldBuf.size()));  // repointed at the end
    REQUIRE(sites1[0].count     == site.count);                            // count unchanged
    // Only the edited instruction's bufferIdx operand changes: mnemonic,
    // offset and count stay the same (requireAllFunctionsUnchanged doesn't
    // apply here - it would also compare bufferIdx, which CHANGES by
    // design).
    REQUIRE(sites1[0].mnemonic          == site.mnemonic);
    REQUIRE(sites1[0].instructionOffset == site.instructionOffset);
}

TEST_CASE("set_literal_value rejects a function with shared bytecode (real bundle)", "[patcher]") {
    auto f = openOrSkip(HBC_CORPUS_DIR "/ridemovi.hbc");
    const auto& sites = f.literal_sites();
    const hbc::LiteralSite* shared = nullptr;
    for (const auto& s : sites)
        if (f.functions()[s.functionIndex].shared) { shared = &s; break; }
    if (!shared) SKIP("no site on a function with shared bytecode in ridemovi.hbc");

    auto m = hbc::Module::from(f);
    REQUIRE_THROWS_WITH(
        m.set_literal_value(shared->functionIndex, shared->instructionOffset,
                            shared->isObject, std::string(1, '\0')),
        Catch::Matchers::ContainsSubstring("private clone"));
}

TEST_CASE("set_literal_value rejects a Short bufferIdx that would overflow (real bundle)", "[patcher]") {
    auto f = openOrSkip(HBC_CORPUS_DIR "/ridemovi.hbc");
    REQUIRE(f.header().arrayBufferSize > 0xFFFFu);   // precondition: already past 64 KB

    const auto& sites = f.literal_sites();
    const hbc::LiteralSite* target = nullptr;
    for (const auto& s : sites) {
        if (s.mnemonic != "NewArrayWithBuffer") continue;   // Short variant only
        if (f.functions()[s.functionIndex].shared) continue;
        target = &s;
        break;
    }
    REQUIRE(target != nullptr);

    auto m = hbc::Module::from(f);
    REQUIRE_THROWS_WITH(
        m.set_literal_value(target->functionIndex, target->instructionOffset, false, std::string(4, '\0')),
        Catch::Matchers::ContainsSubstring("promotion"));
}

    auto f = openOrSkip(HBC_CORPUS_DIR "/literals_g0.hbc");

    {

    }

        m.set_string_value(0, "x");
        REQUIRE_THROWS_AS(m.serialize(), std::runtime_error);
    }
    {

        m.set_literal_value(site.functionIndex, site.instructionOffset, site.isObject, std::string(1, '\0'));
        auto ir = buildIr(f.disasm(0));

        REQUIRE_THROWS_AS(m.serialize(), std::runtime_error);
    }

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// resize_literal: add/remove ONLY at the end
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

TEST_CASE("resize_literal adds an element to a pure array literal", "[patcher]") {
    auto f = openOrSkip(HBC_CORPUS_DIR "/literals_g0.hbc");
    const auto& sites = f.literal_sites();
    if (sites.size() != 1 || sites[0].isObject)
        SKIP("literals_g0.hbc: unexpected compiler layout");
    const auto site = sites[0];
    const auto h0 = f.header();
    const auto oldBuf = f.array_buffer();

    // [10,20,30] + 999 -> Integer run(4): 0x74, then 4 int32 LE.
    static const uint8_t kNewPayload[] = {
        0x74,
        0x0a, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00,
        0x14, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00,
        0x1e, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00,
        0xe7, 0x03, 0x00, 0x00,
    };
    const std::string newBytes(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(kNewPayload), sizeof(kNewPayload));

    auto m = hbc::Module::from(f);
    m.resize_literal(site.functionIndex, site.instructionOffset, site.isObject, /*isAdd=*/true, newBytes);
    auto g = reparse(m.serialize());

    REQUIRE(g.header().arrayBufferSize == h0.arrayBufferSize + newBytes.size());
    const auto newBuf = g.array_buffer();
    REQUIRE(newBuf.substr(0, oldBuf.size()) == oldBuf);   // append-only: prefix intact

    const auto& sites1 = g.literal_sites();
    REQUIRE(sites1.size() == 1);
    REQUIRE(sites1[0].count     == site.count + 1);
    REQUIRE(sites1[0].bufferIdx == static_cast<uint32_t>(oldBuf.size()));

    // sizeHint == count still holds afterwards (it already was == count before the edit).
    auto instrs = g.disasm(site.functionIndex);
    auto it = std::find_if(instrs.begin(), instrs.end(),
                           [&](const hbc::Instruction& x) { return x.offset == site.instructionOffset; });
    REQUIRE(it != instrs.end());
    REQUIRE(opValue(it->operands[1]) == site.count + 1);   // sizeHint
    REQUIRE(opValue(it->operands[2]) == site.count + 1);   // count
}

TEST_CASE("resize_literal removes the last element of a pure array literal", "[patcher]") {
    auto f = openOrSkip(HBC_CORPUS_DIR "/literals_g0.hbc");
    const auto& sites = f.literal_sites();
    if (sites.size() != 1 || sites[0].isObject)
        SKIP("literals_g0.hbc: unexpected compiler layout");
    const auto site = sites[0];

    // [10,20,30] without the last one -> [10,20]: Integer run(2): 0x72, then 2 int32.
    static const uint8_t kNewPayload[] = {
        0x72, 0x0a, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x14, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00,
    };
    const std::string newBytes(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(kNewPayload), sizeof(kNewPayload));

    auto m = hbc::Module::from(f);
    m.resize_literal(site.functionIndex, site.instructionOffset, site.isObject, /*isAdd=*/false, newBytes);
    auto g = reparse(m.serialize());

    const auto& sites1 = g.literal_sites();
    REQUIRE(sites1[0].count == site.count - 1);

    auto instrs = g.disasm(site.functionIndex);
    auto it = std::find_if(instrs.begin(), instrs.end(),
                           [&](const hbc::Instruction& x) { return x.offset == site.instructionOffset; });
    REQUIRE(it != instrs.end());
    REQUIRE(opValue(it->operands[1]) == site.count - 1);   // sizeHint
    REQUIRE(opValue(it->operands[2]) == site.count - 1);   // count
}

TEST_CASE("resize_literal adds a key-value pair to an object literal (both buffers)", "[patcher]") {
    auto f = hbc::HBCFile::open(HBC_CORPUS_DIR "/medium.hbc");
    const auto& sites = f.literal_sites();
    const hbc::LiteralSite* site = nullptr;
    for (const auto& s : sites) if (s.isObject) { site = &s; break; }
    REQUIRE(site != nullptr);
    const auto h0 = f.header();
    const auto oldKeyBuf = f.obj_key_buffer();
    const auto oldValBuf = f.obj_value_buffer();

    // keys 12,14,15 (ByteString) + new key string:0 (ByteString) -> run(4): 0x64.
    static const uint8_t kNewKeys[] = { 0x64, 0x0c, 0x0e, 0x0f, 0x00 };
    // values 1,2,3 (Integer) + new 42 -> run(4): 0x74.
    static const uint8_t kNewVals[] = {
        0x74, 0x01,0,0,0, 0x02,0,0,0, 0x03,0,0,0, 0x2a,0,0,0,
    };
    const std::string newKeyBytes(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(kNewKeys), sizeof(kNewKeys));
    const std::string newValBytes(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(kNewVals), sizeof(kNewVals));

    auto m = hbc::Module::from(f);
    m.resize_literal(site->functionIndex, site->instructionOffset, /*isObject=*/true, /*isAdd=*/true,
                     newValBytes, newKeyBytes);
    auto g = reparse(m.serialize());

    REQUIRE(g.header().objKeyBufferSize   == h0.objKeyBufferSize   + newKeyBytes.size());
    REQUIRE(g.header().objValueBufferSize == h0.objValueBufferSize + newValBytes.size());
    REQUIRE(g.obj_key_buffer().substr(0, oldKeyBuf.size())   == oldKeyBuf);
    REQUIRE(g.obj_value_buffer().substr(0, oldValBuf.size()) == oldValBuf);

    const auto& sites1 = g.literal_sites();
    const hbc::LiteralSite* site1 = nullptr;
    for (const auto& s : sites1) if (s.isObject) { site1 = &s; break; }
    REQUIRE(site1 != nullptr);
    REQUIRE(site1->count        == site->count + 1);
    REQUIRE(site1->bufferIdx    == static_cast<uint32_t>(oldValBuf.size()));
    REQUIRE(site1->keyBufferIdx == static_cast<uint32_t>(oldKeyBuf.size()));
}

TEST_CASE("resize_literal rejects sizeHint != count (mixed literal, real bundle)", "[patcher]") {
    // func[311]@42 in ridemovi.hbc: NewObjectWithBuffer with sizeHint=11,
    // count=2 (mixed literal+dynamic object literal) - found by scanning
    // the corpus (see the implementation notes).
    auto f = openOrSkip(HBC_CORPUS_DIR "/ridemovi.hbc");
    const auto& sites = f.literal_sites();
    const hbc::LiteralSite* mixed = nullptr;
    for (const auto& s : sites) {
        if (s.functionIndex != 311 || s.instructionOffset != 42) continue;
        mixed = &s;
        break;
    }
    if (!mixed) SKIP("func[311]@42 not found - corpus layout changed");
    REQUIRE_FALSE(f.functions()[mixed->functionIndex].shared);

    auto m = hbc::Module::from(f);
    REQUIRE_THROWS_WITH(
        m.resize_literal(mixed->functionIndex, mixed->instructionOffset, mixed->isObject,
                         /*isAdd=*/true, std::string(4, '\0'), std::string(4, '\0')),
        Catch::Matchers::ContainsSubstring("sizeHint"));
}

TEST_CASE("resize_literal rejects removing from an empty site", "[patcher]") {
    // Removes the 3 elements of [10,20,30] one at a time (three separate
    // Module/serialize rounds, re-parsing each time) down to count==0, then
    // checks that a fourth remove raises out_of_range.
    auto f = openOrSkip(HBC_CORPUS_DIR "/literals_g0.hbc");
    const auto& sites0 = f.literal_sites();
    if (sites0.size() != 1 || sites0[0].isObject)
        SKIP("literals_g0.hbc: unexpected compiler layout");

    static const std::string kPayloads[] = {
        std::string("\x72\x0a\x00\x00\x00\x14\x00\x00\x00", 9),   // [10,20]
        std::string("\x71\x0a\x00\x00\x00", 5),                    // [10]
        std::string("", 0),                                        // []
    };

    std::optional<hbc::HBCFile> cur;
    const hbc::HBCFile* curPtr = &f;   // HBCFile isn't copyable: points at f or at *cur
    for (const std::string& payload : kPayloads) {
        const auto& sites = curPtr->literal_sites();
        REQUIRE(sites.size() == 1);
        const auto site = sites[0];
        auto m = hbc::Module::from(*curPtr);
        m.resize_literal(site.functionIndex, site.instructionOffset, site.isObject, false, payload);
        cur.emplace(reparse(m.serialize()));
        curPtr = &*cur;
    }
    REQUIRE(curPtr->literal_sites()[0].count == 0);

    const auto site0 = curPtr->literal_sites()[0];
    auto m = hbc::Module::from(*curPtr);
    REQUIRE_THROWS_AS(
        m.resize_literal(site0.functionIndex, site0.instructionOffset, site0.isObject,
                         false, std::string()),
        std::out_of_range);
}

        auto ir = buildIr(f.disasm(0));

    }
}

TEST_CASE("resize_literal rejects an instruction that is not New{Array,Object}WithBuffer", "[patcher]") {
    auto f = hbc::HBCFile::open(HBC_CORPUS_DIR "/hello.hbc");
    auto m = hbc::Module::from(f);
    REQUIRE_THROWS_AS(
        m.resize_literal(0, 0, false, true, std::string(4, '\0')),
        std::out_of_range);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// add_function: adds a whole new function at the end of the function
// table. Fixed metadata (paramCount=1, functionName=0, strictMode=true,
// prohibitConstruct=true - see the comment in module.cpp), never EH/debug info.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

static std::vector<hbc::AsmInstr> loadUndefinedRetIr() {
    hbc::AsmInstr load;
    load.opcode   = opcodeOf("LoadConstUndefined");
    load.operands = {0.0};
    hbc::AsmInstr ret;
    ret.opcode   = opcodeOf("Ret");
    ret.operands = {0.0};
    return {load, ret};
}

static uint8_t findUnusedOpcode() {
    auto tbl = hbc::opcode_table(96);
    std::vector<bool> used(256, false);
    for (const auto& d : tbl) used[d.opcode] = true;
    for (int i = 0; i < 256; ++i)
        if (!used[i]) return static_cast<uint8_t>(i);
    throw std::runtime_error("add_function test: no free opcode (unexpected)");
}

TEST_CASE("add_function appends a new function with fixed metadata", "[patcher]") {
    auto f = hbc::HBCFile::open(HBC_CORPUS_DIR "/hello.hbc");
    const uint32_t origCount = f.header().functionCount;
    const uint32_t origGlobal = f.header().globalCodeIndex;

    auto m = hbc::Module::from(f);
    uint32_t idx = m.add_function(loadUndefinedRetIr(), 1);
    REQUIRE(idx == origCount);   // always the last index

    auto out = m.serialize();
    auto g = reparse(out);
    REQUIRE(g.header().functionCount   == origCount + 1);
    REQUIRE(g.header().globalCodeIndex == origGlobal);
    REQUIRE(g.header().fileLength      == out.size());

    const auto& fi = g.functions()[idx];
    REQUIRE(fi.paramCount          == 1);
    REQUIRE(fi.frameSize           == 1);
    REQUIRE(fi.hasExceptionHandler == false);
    REQUIRE(fi.hasDebugInfo        == false);
    REQUIRE(fi.overflowed          == false);
    REQUIRE(fi.isStrictMode        == true);
    // prohibitInvoke = None (2): callable and constructible, like a plain
    // `function`. 0 would be ProhibitCall ("Class constructor invoked without
    // new" on every Call) - see the comment in module.cpp.
    REQUIRE(fi.prohibitCall        == false);
    REQUIRE(fi.prohibitConstruct   == false);
    const uint8_t newFlags = out[sizeof(hbc::HBCFileHeader) + idx * sizeof(hbc::SmallFuncHeader) + 15];
    REQUIRE((newFlags & 0x3) == hbc::kProhibitInvokeNone);
}

// flags bits 0-1 are the 2-bit ProhibitInvoke enum (0 = Call prohibited,
// 1 = Construct prohibited, 2 = None), not two independent bits. hermes v96
// emits 2 for a plain function and 1 for arrow / async / generator functions.
TEST_CASE("prohibitInvoke is decoded as a 2-bit enum", "[patcher]") {
    auto f = openOrSkip(HBC_CORPUS_DIR "/invoke_kinds.hbc");
    auto byName = [&](const char* n) -> const hbc::FunctionInfo& {
        for (const auto& fn : f.functions()) if (fn.name == n) return fn;
        FAIL("function not found: " << n);
        throw std::logic_error("unreachable");
    };
    for (const char* n : {"plainDecl", "shorthandMethod"}) {
        INFO(n);
        REQUIRE_FALSE(byName(n).prohibitCall);
        REQUIRE_FALSE(byName(n).prohibitConstruct);
    }
    for (const char* n : {"arrowFn", "asyncFn", "genFn"}) {
        INFO(n);
        REQUIRE_FALSE(byName(n).prohibitCall);
        REQUIRE(byName(n).prohibitConstruct);
    }
}

// Rewrites bits 0-1 of `name`'s flags on a raw image and re-parses it.
static hbc::HBCFile withProhibitInvoke(const hbc::HBCFile& f, const char* name, uint8_t v) {
    std::string bytes(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(f.raw_data()), f.raw_size());
    for (const auto& fn : f.functions())
        if (fn.name == name) {
            auto* fh = reinterpret_cast<hbc::SmallFuncHeader*>(bytes.data() + sizeof(hbc::HBCFileHeader));
            fh[fn.index].flags.prohibitInvoke = v;
        }
    return hbc::HBCFile::from_bytes(bytes);
}

TEST_CASE("prohibitInvoke values 0..3 map to prohibitCall / prohibitConstruct", "[patcher]") {
    auto f = openOrSkip(HBC_CORPUS_DIR "/invoke_kinds.hbc");
    struct { uint8_t v; bool call, ctor; } cases[] = {
        {0, true,  false},   // ProhibitCall
        {1, false, true},    // ProhibitConstruct
        {2, false, false},   // ProhibitNone
        {3, false, false},   // VM: `prohibitInvoke == isConstructCall` -> never prohibited
    };
    for (const auto& c : cases) {
        INFO("prohibitInvoke = " << int(c.v));
        auto g = withProhibitInvoke(f, "plainDecl", c.v);
        for (const auto& fn : g.functions())
            if (fn.name == "plainDecl") {
                REQUIRE(fn.prohibitCall      == c.call);
                REQUIRE(fn.prohibitConstruct == c.ctor);
            }
    }
}

TEST_CASE("add_function's new body disassembles back to the input IR", "[patcher]") {
    auto f = hbc::HBCFile::open(HBC_CORPUS_DIR "/hello.hbc");
    auto m = hbc::Module::from(f);
    uint32_t idx = m.add_function(loadUndefinedRetIr(), 1);
    auto g = reparse(m.serialize());

    auto d = g.disasm(idx);
    REQUIRE(d.size() == 2);
    REQUIRE(d[0].mnemonic == "LoadConstUndefined");
    REQUIRE(d[1].mnemonic == "Ret");
    REQUIRE(static_cast<uint32_t>(d[0].operands[0].u32) == 0u);
    REQUIRE(static_cast<uint32_t>(d[1].operands[0].u32) == 0u);
}

TEST_CASE("add_function preserves every existing function's body (hello.hbc)", "[patcher]") {
    auto f = hbc::HBCFile::open(HBC_CORPUS_DIR "/hello.hbc");
    const uint32_t origCount = f.header().functionCount;

    auto m = hbc::Module::from(f);
    m.add_function(loadUndefinedRetIr(), 1);
    auto g = reparse(m.serialize());

    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < origCount; ++i) {
        auto x = f.disasm(i);
        auto y = g.disasm(i);
        REQUIRE(x.size() == y.size());
        for (size_t k = 0; k < x.size(); ++k) {
            REQUIRE(x[k].mnemonic == y[k].mnemonic);
            REQUIRE(x[k].operands.size() == y[k].operands.size());
            for (size_t o = 0; o < x[k].operands.size(); ++o)
                REQUIRE(opValue(x[k].operands[o]) == opValue(y[k].operands[o]));
        }
    }
}

TEST_CASE("add_function rejects bytecode size >= 32768 B", "[patcher]") {
    auto f = hbc::HBCFile::open(HBC_CORPUS_DIR "/hello.hbc");
    auto m = hbc::Module::from(f);

    std::vector<hbc::AsmInstr> ir;
    ir.reserve(16385);
    hbc::AsmInstr load;
    load.opcode   = opcodeOf("LoadConstUndefined");
    load.operands = {0.0};
    for (int i = 0; i < 16384; ++i) ir.push_back(load);   // 16384 * 2 B = 32768 B
    hbc::AsmInstr ret;
    ret.opcode   = opcodeOf("Ret");
    ret.operands = {0.0};
    ir.push_back(ret);

    m.add_function(ir, 1);
    REQUIRE_THROWS_WITH(m.serialize(), Catch::Matchers::ContainsSubstring("32768"));
}

TEST_CASE("add_function is not combinable with set_function_body / add_string / "
         "set_string_value / set_literal_value / resize_literal", "[patcher]") {
    auto f = openOrSkip(HBC_CORPUS_DIR "/literals_g0.hbc");
    const auto& sites = f.literal_sites();
    if (sites.empty()) SKIP("literals_g0.hbc: no site");
    const auto site = sites[0];

    {
        auto m = hbc::Module::from(f);
        m.add_function(loadUndefinedRetIr(), 1);
        auto ir = buildIr(f.disasm(0));
        m.set_function_body(0, ir, f.functions()[0].frameSize);
        REQUIRE_THROWS_AS(m.serialize(), std::runtime_error);
    }
    {
        auto m = hbc::Module::from(f);
        m.add_function(loadUndefinedRetIr(), 1);
        m.add_string("newstr");
        REQUIRE_THROWS_AS(m.serialize(), std::runtime_error);
    }
    {
        auto m = hbc::Module::from(f);
        m.add_function(loadUndefinedRetIr(), 1);
        m.set_string_value(0, "x");
        REQUIRE_THROWS_AS(m.serialize(), std::runtime_error);
    }
    {
        auto m = hbc::Module::from(f);
        m.add_function(loadUndefinedRetIr(), 1);
        m.set_literal_value(site.functionIndex, site.instructionOffset, site.isObject, std::string(1, '\0'));
        REQUIRE_THROWS_AS(m.serialize(), std::runtime_error);
    }
    {
        auto m = hbc::Module::from(f);
        m.add_function(loadUndefinedRetIr(), 1);
        m.resize_literal(site.functionIndex, site.instructionOffset, site.isObject, true, std::string(4, '\0'));
        REQUIRE_THROWS_AS(m.serialize(), std::runtime_error);
    }
}
```

`tests/unit/patcher/test_string_edit.cpp`:

```cpp
// =============================================================================
// test_string_edit.cpp - per-string metadata accessor
// =============================================================================
// hbc::HBCFile::string_entries() exposes (absolute offset, bytes, characters,
// encoding, overflow, kind) for every string: the `edit string:<idx>` patcher
// uses it to do a same-length splice on the string storage.
// HBC_CORPUS_DIR is injected by CMake.
// =============================================================================

#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>

#include "hbc/hbc.h"
#include "test_util.h"

#include <cstdint>
#include <fstream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

using testutil::openOrSkip;

static const std::string HELLO = std::string(HBC_CORPUS_DIR) + "/hello.hbc";

// Index of the first string equal to `want`, or -1.
static int idxOf(const hbc::HBCFile& f, const std::string& want) {
    const auto& ss = f.strings();
    for (size_t i = 0; i < ss.size(); ++i)
        if (ss[i] == want) return static_cast<int>(i);
    return -1;
}

// True if a's and b's half-open storage ranges intersect.
static bool overlaps(const hbc::StringEntry& a, const hbc::StringEntry& b) {
    uint32_t a0 = a.storageOffset, a1 = a0 + a.byteLength;
    uint32_t b0 = b.storageOffset, b1 = b0 + b.byteLength;
    return a0 < b1 && b0 < a1;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

TEST_CASE("string_entries parallel to strings/string_kinds", "[patcher]") {
    auto f = hbc::HBCFile::open(HELLO);
    const auto& ents  = f.string_entries();
    const auto& kinds = f.stringKinds();

    REQUIRE(ents.size() == f.header().stringCount);
    REQUIRE(ents.size() == kinds.size());
    for (size_t i = 0; i < ents.size(); ++i)
        REQUIRE(ents[i].kind == kinds[i]);
}

TEST_CASE("string_entries offsets and byte lengths are coherent", "[patcher]") {
    auto f = hbc::HBCFile::open(HELLO);
    const auto& ents = f.string_entries();
    const auto& ss   = f.strings();

    // start of the string storage from the section map
    uint32_t storageStart = 0;
    for (const auto& s : f.section_map())
        if (s.name == "string storage") storageStart = s.offset;
    REQUIRE(storageStart != 0);

    const uint32_t limit = f.header().fileLength - 20;  // footer excluded
    for (size_t i = 0; i < ents.size(); ++i) {
        const auto& e = ents[i];
        REQUIRE(e.storageOffset >= storageStart);
        REQUIRE(e.storageOffset + e.byteLength <= limit);
        if (!e.isOverflow)
            REQUIRE(e.byteLength == (e.isUTF16 ? e.charLength * 2 : e.charLength));
        if (!e.isUTF16)  // all-ASCII corpus: bytes == characters == len(std::string)
            REQUIRE(ss[i].size() == e.byteLength);
    }
}

TEST_CASE("hello.hbc \"Hello, \" is a standalone String entry", "[patcher]") {
    auto f = hbc::HBCFile::open(HELLO);
    const auto& ents = f.string_entries();
    int i = idxOf(f, "Hello, ");
    REQUIRE(i == 1);

    const auto& e = ents[i];
    REQUIRE_FALSE(e.isOverflow);
    REQUIRE_FALSE(e.isUTF16);
    REQUIRE(e.kind == hbc::StringKind::String);
    REQUIRE(e.byteLength == 7);

    for (size_t j = 0; j < ents.size(); ++j)
        if (static_cast<int>(j) != i && ents[j].byteLength != 0)
            REQUIRE_FALSE(overlaps(e, ents[j]));
}

TEST_CASE("hello.hbc \"log\" and \"global\" storage ranges overlap", "[patcher]") {
    auto f = hbc::HBCFile::open(HELLO);
    const auto& ents = f.string_entries();
    int a = idxOf(f, "log"), b = idxOf(f, "global");
    REQUIRE(a >= 0);
    REQUIRE(b >= 0);
    REQUIRE(overlaps(ents[a], ents[b]));
}

TEST_CASE("hello.hbc identifier strings carry kind Identifier", "[patcher]") {
    auto f = hbc::HBCFile::open(HELLO);
    const auto& ents = f.string_entries();
    for (const char* name : {"log", "console", "greet"}) {
        int i = idxOf(f, name);
        REQUIRE(i >= 0);
        REQUIRE(ents[i].kind == hbc::StringKind::Identifier);
    }
}

TEST_CASE("string_entries cache is idempotent", "[patcher]") {
    auto f = hbc::HBCFile::open(HELLO);
    REQUIRE(&f.string_entries() == &f.string_entries());
}

TEST_CASE("string_entries survive a serialize round-trip", "[patcher]") {
    auto f = hbc::HBCFile::open(HELLO);
    auto bytes = f.serialize();
    auto g = hbc::HBCFile::from_bytes(std::string(bytes.begin(), bytes.end()));

    const auto& a = f.string_entries();
    const auto& b = g.string_entries();
    REQUIRE(a.size() == b.size());
    for (size_t i = 0; i < a.size(); ++i) {
        REQUIRE(a[i].storageOffset == b[i].storageOffset);
        REQUIRE(a[i].byteLength    == b[i].byteLength);
        REQUIRE(a[i].charLength    == b[i].charLength);
        REQUIRE(a[i].isUTF16       == b[i].isUTF16);
        REQUIRE(a[i].isOverflow    == b[i].isOverflow);
        REQUIRE(a[i].kind          == b[i].kind);
    }
}

TEST_CASE("greeting_g0.hbc \"Hello, world\" entry is editable-shaped", "[patcher]") {
    auto f = openOrSkip(std::string(HBC_CORPUS_DIR) + "/greeting_g0.hbc");
    const auto& ents = f.string_entries();
    int i = idxOf(f, "Hello, world");
    if (i < 0)
        SKIP("greeting_g0.hbc does not contain \"Hello, world\" (compiler layout)");

    const auto& e = ents[i];
    REQUIRE(e.kind == hbc::StringKind::String);
    REQUIRE_FALSE(e.isOverflow);
    REQUIRE_FALSE(e.isUTF16);
    REQUIRE(e.byteLength == 12);
    for (size_t j = 0; j < ents.size(); ++j)
        if (static_cast<int>(j) != i && ents[j].byteLength != 0)
            REQUIRE_FALSE(overlaps(e, ents[j]));
}
```

```cpp
TEST_CASE("serialize is byte-identical to source", "[roundtrip][roundtrip]") {
    auto f = hbc::HBCFile::open(HELLO);
    auto bytes = f.serialize();
    REQUIRE(bytes.size() == f.raw_size());

    const auto& last = smap.back();
    REQUIRE(last.offset + last.size == f.header().fileLength);

TEST_CASE("section_map has no gaps between contiguous sections", "[roundtrip][section_map]") {
    auto f = hbc::HBCFile::open(HELLO);
    auto smap = f.section_map();
    for (size_t i = 1; i < smap.size(); ++i) {
        uint32_t prev_end  = smap[i-1].offset + smap[i-1].size;
        uint32_t curr_start = smap[i].offset;
        // There can be alignment padding between sections (< 4 bytes), but never overlap
        REQUIRE(curr_start >= prev_end);
        REQUIRE(curr_start - prev_end < 4);
    }
}
```

`tests/unit/string-table/test_string_table.cpp`:

```cpp
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>
#include "hbc/hbc.h"
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

static const std::string HELLO = std::string(HBC_CORPUS_DIR) + "/hello.hbc";

TEST_CASE("string count matches header stringCount", "[string-table][strings]") {
    auto f = hbc::HBCFile::open(HELLO);
    REQUIRE(f.strings().size() == f.header().stringCount);
}

TEST_CASE("hello.hbc contains expected strings", "[string-table][strings]") {
    auto f = hbc::HBCFile::open(HELLO);
    const auto& strs = f.strings();
    auto has = [&](const std::string& s) {
        return std::find(strs.begin(), strs.end(), s) != strs.end();
    };
    REQUIRE(has("greet"));
    REQUIRE(has("console"));
    REQUIRE(has("log"));
    REQUIRE(has("global"));
    REQUIRE(has("use strict"));
}

TEST_CASE("strings() is idempotent (cache)", "[string-table][strings]") {
    auto f = hbc::HBCFile::open(HELLO);
    const auto& a = f.strings();
    const auto& b = f.strings();
    REQUIRE(a.size() == b.size());
    REQUIRE(&a == &b);  // same reference: the cache works
}

// Narrow (isUTF16=0) string storage is CESU-8, not plain UTF-8: a
// supplementary character (U+10000+, e.g. most emoji) is split into two
// independently UTF-8-encoded UTF-16 surrogate halves instead of UTF-8's
// single 4-byte sequence. This builds a minimal synthetic file (just
// enough for HBCFile::from_bytes() + strings(): header + one
// SmallStringTableEntry + its storage bytes, no other section) containing
// the CESU-8 encoding of U+1F600 (high surrogate D83D, low surrogate
// DE00 - each a 3-byte CESU-8 sequence: ED A0 BD / ED B8 80) and checks
// that strings() recombines them into the real 4-byte UTF-8 encoding
// (F0 9F 98 80), not two separate invalid/mangled sequences.
TEST_CASE("narrow CESU-8 surrogate pair decodes to real UTF-8", "[string-table][strings][cesu8]") {
    hbc::HBCFileHeader hdr{};
    hdr.magic             = hbc::HBC_MAGIC;
    hdr.version           = 96;
    hdr.stringCount       = 1;
    hdr.stringStorageSize = 6;

    hbc::SmallStringTableEntry entry{};
    entry.isUTF16 = 0;
    entry.offset  = 0;
    entry.length  = 6;  // byte count for narrow strings, not character count

    const uint8_t cesu8[6] = {0xED, 0xA0, 0xBD, 0xED, 0xB8, 0x80};

    std::string buf(sizeof(hdr) + sizeof(entry) + sizeof(cesu8), '\0');
    std::memcpy(buf.data(), &hdr, sizeof(hdr));
    std::memcpy(buf.data() + sizeof(hdr), &entry, sizeof(entry));
    std::memcpy(buf.data() + sizeof(hdr) + sizeof(entry), cesu8, sizeof(cesu8));

    hdr.fileLength = static_cast<uint32_t>(buf.size());
    std::memcpy(buf.data(), &hdr, sizeof(hdr));  // rewrite header with fileLength set

    auto f = hbc::HBCFile::from_bytes(buf);
    const auto& strs = f.strings();
    REQUIRE(strs.size() == 1);
    REQUIRE(strs[0] == std::string("\xF0\x9F\x98\x80", 4));
}

// A small entry with length == 255 carries in `offset` the index of its entry in
// the Overflow String Table (Hermes' BytecodeDataProvider::getStringTableEntry
// reads overflowStringTableEntries_[small.offset]). The synthetic files below
// name the slots in descending order, name the same slot twice and name a slot
// outside the table.
static std::string buildOverflowFile(const std::vector<uint32_t>& sentinelIndices,
                                     uint32_t overflowCount) {
    // String table: [sentinel, small "x", sentinel ...]; storage "alphabravo!x".
    //   overflow slot 0 = "alpha"  (offset 0, length 5)
    //   overflow slot 1 = "bravo!" (offset 5, length 6)
    const uint8_t storage[] = {'a','l','p','h','a','b','r','a','v','o','!','x'};
    const uint32_t stringCount = static_cast<uint32_t>(sentinelIndices.size()) + 1;

    hbc::HBCFileHeader hdr{};
    hdr.magic                = hbc::HBC_MAGIC;
    hdr.version              = 96;
    hdr.stringCount          = stringCount;
    hdr.overflowStringCount  = overflowCount;
    hdr.stringStorageSize    = sizeof(storage);

    std::vector<hbc::SmallStringTableEntry> small;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sentinelIndices.size(); ++i) {
        hbc::SmallStringTableEntry e{};
        e.isUTF16 = 0;
        e.offset  = sentinelIndices[i];
        e.length  = 255;
        small.push_back(e);
        if (i == 0) {                       // a plain small entry between the sentinels
            hbc::SmallStringTableEntry s{};
            s.isUTF16 = 0; s.offset = 11; s.length = 1;
            small.push_back(s);
        }
    }
    const hbc::OverflowStringTableEntry ovf[2] = {{0, 5}, {5, 6}};

    std::string buf(sizeof(hdr) + small.size() * 4 + overflowCount * 8 + sizeof(storage), '\0');
    size_t pos = sizeof(hdr);
    std::memcpy(buf.data() + pos, small.data(), small.size() * 4);   pos += small.size() * 4;
    std::memcpy(buf.data() + pos, ovf, overflowCount * 8);           pos += overflowCount * 8;
    std::memcpy(buf.data() + pos, storage, sizeof(storage));
    hdr.fileLength = static_cast<uint32_t>(buf.size());
    std::memcpy(buf.data(), &hdr, sizeof(hdr));
    return buf;
}

TEST_CASE("overflow entry is addressed by the small entry's offset",
          "[string-table][strings][overflow]") {
    // [0] -> slot 1, [1] = plain "x", [2] -> slot 0
    auto f = hbc::HBCFile::from_bytes(buildOverflowFile({1, 0}, 2));
    const auto& strs = f.strings();
    REQUIRE(strs.size() == 3);
    REQUIRE(strs[0] == "bravo!");
    REQUIRE(strs[1] == "x");
    REQUIRE(strs[2] == "alpha");
}

TEST_CASE("two entries may refer to the same overflow slot",
          "[string-table][strings][overflow]") {
    auto f = hbc::HBCFile::from_bytes(buildOverflowFile({1, 1}, 2));
    const auto& strs = f.strings();
    REQUIRE(strs[0] == "bravo!");
    REQUIRE(strs[2] == "bravo!");
}

TEST_CASE("overflow index outside the table is rejected",
          "[string-table][strings][overflow]") {
    auto f = hbc::HBCFile::from_bytes(buildOverflowFile({2, 0}, 2));
    REQUIRE_THROWS_AS(f.strings(), std::runtime_error);
}

```

`tests/unit/test_util.h`:

```h
// Helpers shared by the unit tests.
#pragma once

#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>

#include "hbc/hbc.h"

#include <fstream>
#include <string>

// HBC_CORPUS_DIR is injected by CMake so tests find the corpus from any working directory.
#ifndef HBC_CORPUS_DIR
#  error "HBC_CORPUS_DIR must be set by CMake"
#endif

namespace testutil {

// Opens a corpus file; skips the test if it isn't there. Several corpus files
// (`*_g0.hbc`, ridemovi.hbc, ...) are gitignored and generated with
//   .venv/bin/python -m seeder.compile --g0 seeder/samples/<sample>
inline hbc::HBCFile openOrSkip(const std::string& path) {
    std::ifstream probe(path, std::ios::binary);
    if (!probe.good())
        SKIP("missing corpus: " + path + "  (regenerate with `seeder.compile --g0`)");
    return hbc::HBCFile::open(path);
}

// Numeric value of an operand: Imm32/Addr8/Addr32 live in i32, Double in f64,
// everything else (Reg*, UInt*, string index) in u32.
inline double opValue(const hbc::Operand& op) {
    using T = hbc::Operand::Type;
    switch (op.type) {
        case T::Imm32:
        case T::Addr8:
        case T::Addr32: return static_cast<double>(op.i32);
        case T::Double: return op.f64;
        default:        return static_cast<double>(op.u32);
    }
}

} // namespace testutil

```

```cpp
// test_xrefs.cpp - Unit tests for String XREFs + Call Graph + Modules
// =============================================================================
// Ground truth derived from disassembling hello.hbc:
//
//   func 0 (global):
//     0x0000  DeclareGlobalVar  "greet"      [identifier]
//     0x000E  PutById           ..., "greet" [identifier]
//     0x0014  GetByIdShort      ..., "greet" [identifier]
//     0x001B  LoadConstString   "hermit"     [string]
//     0x0024  LoadConstString   "use strict" [string]
//
//   func 1 (greet):
//     0x0000  LoadConstString  "Hello, "  [string]
//     0x000B  LoadConstString  "!"        [string]
//     0x0015  TryGetById       "console"  [identifier]
//     0x001B  GetByIdShort     "log"      [identifier]
//
//   Total: 7 referenced strings, 9 sites.
// =============================================================================
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>
#include "hbc/hbc.h"
#include <limits>
#include <set>
#include <string>

static const std::string HELLO        = std::string(HBC_CORPUS_DIR) + "/hello.hbc";
static const std::string CTRL_FLOW    = std::string(HBC_CORPUS_DIR) + "/control_flow.hbc";
static const std::string FUNCTIONS    = std::string(HBC_CORPUS_DIR) + "/functions.hbc";

static const hbc::StringXRef* findXRef(
    const std::vector<hbc::StringXRef>& xs, const std::string& val)
{
    for (const auto& x : xs)
        if (x.stringValue == val) return &x;
    return nullptr;
}

static bool hasSite(const hbc::StringXRef& xr, uint32_t funcIdx, uint32_t offset)
{
    for (const auto& s : xr.sites)
        if (s.functionIndex == funcIdx && s.instructionOffset == offset)
            return true;
    return false;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

}
```

`tools/gen_opcode_table_typ.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generates a compact Typst table of the HBC v96 opcodes (the appendix of the thesis).

Reads core/src/format/opcodes_v96.cpp (itself generated by seeder/gen_opcodes.py)
and writes a Typst fragment with: opcode, mnemonic, typed operands and total
instruction size in bytes.

Usage, from the repository root:
    .venv/bin/python tools/gen_opcode_table_typ.py <output.typ>
"""
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

SRC = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "core/src/format/opcodes_v96.cpp"

# tipo fisico (nome esatto del sorgente) -> byte
TYPES = {
    "Reg8": 1, "Reg32": 4, "UInt8": 1, "UInt16": 2, "UInt32": 4,
    "Imm32": 4, "Double": 8, "Addr8": 1, "Addr32": 4,
}

ROW = re.compile(
    r'/\*\s*0x([0-9A-F]{2})\s*\*/\s*\{\s*"(\w+)",\s*(\d+),\s*\{([^}]*)\},\s*0x([0-9A-Fa-f]+)'
)


def parse(text):
    rows = []
    for m in ROW.finditer(text):
        op, name, n, ops, mask = m.groups()
        types = re.findall(r"OperandType::(\w+)", ops)
        assert len(types) == int(n), (name, types, n)
        mask = int(mask, 16)
        cols, size = [], 1  # 1 byte di opcode
        for i, t in enumerate(types):
            nb = TYPES[t]
            sig = t + ("*" if mask >> i & 1 else "")  # * = indice in String Table
            cols.append(sig)
            size += nb
        rows.append((op, name, cols, size))
    return rows


def main():
    out = Path(sys.argv[1])
    rows = parse(SRC.read_text())
    lines = [
        "// GENERATO da hermit/tools/gen_opcode_table_typ.py a partire da",
        "// core/src/format/opcodes_v96.cpp. NON modificare a mano.",
        f"// {len(rows)} opcode definiti su 256.",
        "#pagebreak(weak: true)",
        "#set text(size: 9.5pt)",
        "#table(",
        "  columns: (auto, auto, 1fr, auto),",
        "  align: (center, left, left, center),",
        "  inset: (x: 4pt, y: 2.5pt),",
        "  table.header(repeat: true, [*Op*], [*Mnemonic*], [*Operandi*], [*B*]),",
    ]
    for op, name, cols, size in rows:
        ops = ", ".join(cols) if cols else "—"
        lines.append(f"  [`{op}`], [`{name}`], [`{ops}`], [{size}],")
    lines += [")"]
    out.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n")
    print(f"{len(rows)} opcode -> {out}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

```

`tools/hbc-disasm.cpp`:

```cpp
// hbc_disasm <file.hbc> [func:<N>] [--output|-o <out.txt>]
//
// Disassembles every function (or just function N) to stdout or a file:
//
//  *func global (js_params: 0, hbc_params: 1, regs: 4)
//     0x0000  GetGlobalObject     r0
//   func greet (js_params: 1, hbc_params: 2, regs: 11)
//     0x0000  LoadParam           r0, 1
//     0x0002  LoadConstString     r1, "Hello, " [string]

#include "hbc/hbc.h"

#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

// Operand as text; a string shows its kind outside the quotes: "value" [kind].
static std::string formatOperand(const hbc::Operand& op) {
    using T = hbc::Operand::Type;
    char buf[64];
    switch (op.type) {
        case T::Reg8:
        case T::Reg32:
            std::snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "r%u", op.u32);
            return buf;

        case T::UInt8:
        case T::UInt16:
        case T::UInt32:
            std::snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%u", op.u32);
            return buf;

        case T::Imm32:
            std::snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%d", op.i32);
            return buf;

        case T::Double:
            std::snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%g", op.f64);
            return buf;

        case T::Addr8:
        case T::Addr32:
            // Relative jump offsets, signed.
            if (op.i32 >= 0)
                std::snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "+%d", op.i32);
            else
                std::snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%d", op.i32);
            return buf;

        case T::StringID: {
            // resolvedString = "value [kind]" - kind outside the quotes: "value" [kind]
            const auto& s = op.resolvedString;
            auto pos = s.rfind(" [");
            if (pos != std::string::npos)
                return "\"" + s.substr(0, pos) + "\" " + s.substr(pos + 1);
            return "\"" + s + "\"";
        }
    }
    return "?";
}

static void printFunction(const hbc::HBCFile& f, uint32_t idx, FILE* out) {
    const auto& fi = f.functions()[idx];
    const auto& h  = f.header();

    // js_params = paramCount - 1 (the implicit `this` is excluded)
    bool isGlobal = (idx == h.globalCodeIndex);
    std::fprintf(out, "\nfunc %s (js_params: %u, hbc_params: %u, regs: %u",
        fi.name.c_str(),
        fi.paramCount > 0 ? fi.paramCount - 1 : 0,
        fi.paramCount,
        fi.frameSize);

    if (fi.isStrictMode || fi.isAsync || fi.isGenerator) {
        std::fprintf(out, ",");
        if (fi.isStrictMode) std::fprintf(out, " strict");
        if (fi.isGenerator)  std::fprintf(out, " generator");
        if (fi.isAsync)      std::fprintf(out, " async");
    }
    // * marks the global function (entry point)
    std::fprintf(out, ") <fun_id: %u>%s\n", idx, isGlobal ? " *" : "");

    auto instrs = f.disasm(idx);

    if (instrs.empty()) {
        std::fprintf(out, "  <no instructions>\n");
        return;
    }

    for (const auto& instr : instrs) {
        std::fprintf(out, "  0x%04X  ", instr.offset);
        std::fprintf(out, "%-20s", instr.mnemonic.c_str());
        // A mnemonic of 20+ chars would run into the first operand.
        if (!instr.operands.empty() && instr.mnemonic.size() >= 20)
            std::fprintf(out, " ");

        bool first = true;
        for (const auto& op : instr.operands) {
            if (!first) std::fprintf(out, ", ");
            std::fprintf(out, "%s", formatOperand(op).c_str());
            first = false;
        }
        std::fprintf(out, "\n");
    }
}

static void printUsage(const char* prog) {
    std::fprintf(stderr,
        "Usage: %s <file.hbc> [func:<N>] [--output|-o <out.txt>]\n"
        "\n"
        "  Without func:   disassembles every function.\n"
        "  func:<N>:       disassembles only the function at index N.\n"
        "  --output/-o:    writes the output to a file instead of stdout.\n"
        "\n"
        "Examples:\n"
        "  %s hello.hbc\n"
        "  %s hello.hbc func:1\n"
        "  %s hello.hbc --output hello_disasm.txt\n"
        "  %s hello.hbc func:1 -o greet.txt\n",
        prog, prog, prog, prog, prog);
}

int main(int argc, char* argv[]) {
    if (argc < 2) {
        printUsage(argv[0]);
        return 1;
    }

    const char* hbcPath    = argv[1];
    const char* outputPath = nullptr;   // nullptr = stdout
    int32_t     funcFilter = -1;        // -1 = all functions

    for (int i = 2; i < argc; i++) {
        if (std::strncmp(argv[i], "func:", 5) == 0) {
            funcFilter = static_cast<int32_t>(std::strtol(argv[i] + 5, nullptr, 10));

        } else if ((std::strcmp(argv[i], "--output") == 0 ||
                    std::strcmp(argv[i], "-o") == 0) && i + 1 < argc) {
            outputPath = argv[++i];

        } else {
            std::fprintf(stderr, "Unknown argument: %s\n\n", argv[i]);
            printUsage(argv[0]);
            return 1;
        }
    }

    hbc::HBCFile f = [&]() -> hbc::HBCFile {
        try {
            return hbc::HBCFile::open(hbcPath);
        } catch (const std::exception& e) {
            std::fprintf(stderr, "Error opening '%s': %s\n", hbcPath, e.what());
            std::exit(1);
        }
    }();

    FILE* out = stdout;
    if (outputPath) {
        out = std::fopen(outputPath, "w");
        if (!out) {
            std::fprintf(stderr, "Error opening output '%s'\n", outputPath);
            return 1;
        }
    }

    const auto& h = f.header();

    std::fprintf(out, "HBC v%u  |  %u functions  |  global: func[%u]",
        f.version(), h.functionCount, h.globalCodeIndex);
    if (outputPath)
        std::fprintf(out, "  |  -> %s", outputPath);
    std::fprintf(out, "\n");

    if (funcFilter >= 0) {
        uint32_t idx = static_cast<uint32_t>(funcFilter);
        if (idx >= h.functionCount) {
            std::fprintf(stderr, "Error: index %u out of range (functionCount=%u)\n",
                         idx, h.functionCount);
            if (outputPath) std::fclose(out);
            return 1;
        }
        printFunction(f, idx, out);
    } else {
        for (uint32_t idx = 0; idx < h.functionCount; idx++)
            printFunction(f, idx, out);
    }

    std::fprintf(out, "\n");

    if (outputPath) {
        std::fclose(out);
        std::fprintf(stdout, "Output written to: %s\n", outputPath);
    }

    return 0;
}
```

`tools/hbc-dump.cpp`:

```cpp
// hbc_dump <file.hbc>: prints every field of the HBC header.

#include "hbc/hbc.h"
#include "hbc/format.h"

#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <iomanip>
#include <sstream>

// {0x7E, 0xED, 0x64} -> "7E ED 64"
static std::string hex_bytes(const uint8_t* data, size_t len) {
    std::ostringstream ss;
    ss << std::hex << std::uppercase << std::setfill('0');
    for (size_t i = 0; i < len; ++i) {
        if (i > 0) ss << ' ';
        ss << std::setw(2) << static_cast<unsigned>(data[i]);
    }
    return ss.str();
}

static void dump(const hbc::HBCFile& f) {
    const auto& h = f.header();
    hbc::BytecodeOptions opts{h.options};

    std::printf("%-28s 0x%016llX  ✓\n", "Magic:",
                static_cast<unsigned long long>(h.magic));
    std::printf("%-28s %u\n",           "Version:",              h.version);
    std::printf("%-28s %s\n",           "Source SHA-1:",
                hex_bytes(h.sourceHash, 20).c_str());
    std::printf("%-28s %u bytes\n",     "File length:",          h.fileLength);
    std::printf("%-28s %u\n",           "Global code index:",    h.globalCodeIndex);
    std::printf("%-28s %u\n",           "Function count:",       h.functionCount);
    std::printf("%-28s %u\n",           "String kind count:",    h.stringKindCount);
    std::printf("%-28s %u\n",           "Identifier count:",     h.identifierCount);
    std::printf("%-28s %u\n",           "String count:",         h.stringCount);
    std::printf("%-28s %u\n",           "Overflow string count:", h.overflowStringCount);
    std::printf("%-28s %u bytes\n",     "String storage:",       h.stringStorageSize);
    std::printf("%-28s %u\n",           "BigInt count:",         h.bigIntCount);
    std::printf("%-28s %u bytes\n",     "BigInt storage:",       h.bigIntStorageSize);
    std::printf("%-28s %u\n",           "RegExp count:",         h.regExpCount);
    std::printf("%-28s %u bytes\n",     "RegExp storage:",       h.regExpStorageSize);
    std::printf("%-28s %u bytes\n",     "Array buffer:",         h.arrayBufferSize);
    std::printf("%-28s %u bytes\n",     "Object key buffer:",    h.objKeyBufferSize);
    std::printf("%-28s %u bytes\n",     "Object value buffer:",  h.objValueBufferSize);
    std::printf("%-28s %u\n",           "Segment ID:",           h.segmentID);
    std::printf("%-28s %u\n",           "CJS module count:",     h.cjsModuleCount);
    std::printf("%-28s %u\n",           "Function source count:", h.functionSourceCount);
    std::printf("%-28s 0x%08X\n",       "Debug info offset:",    h.debugInfoOffset);
    std::printf("%-28s 0x%02X  (staticBuiltins=%d cjsStatic=%d hasAsync=%d)\n",
                "Options:", h.options,
                opts.bits.staticBuiltins,
                opts.bits.cjsModulesStaticallyResolved,
                opts.bits.hasAsync);
}

int main(int argc, char* argv[]) {
    if (argc != 2) {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "Usage: hbc-dump <file.hbc>\n");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }
    try {
        dump(hbc::HBCFile::open(argv[1]));
    } catch (const std::exception& e) {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "Error: %s\n", e.what());
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }
    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
}
```

`tools/hbc-functions.cpp`:

```cpp
// hbc_functions <file.hbc>: the function table, one row per function.
// `*` marks the global function (entry point); anonymous functions are shown
// as "anonymous_func_N".

#include "hbc/hbc.h"
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>

int main(int argc, char* argv[]) {
    if (argc != 2) {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "Usage: hbc-functions <file.hbc>\n");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }
    try {
        hbc::HBCFile f = hbc::HBCFile::open(argv[1]);
        const auto&    funcs  = f.functions();
        const uint32_t global = f.header().globalCodeIndex;

        std::printf("HBC version: %u\n", f.version());
        std::printf("Function count: %zu  |  Global index: %u\n\n",
            funcs.size(), global);

        std::printf("%-6s  %-30s  %-10s  %-6s  %-6s  %-5s  %s\n",
            "Index", "Name", "Offset", "Size", "Params", "Frame", "Flags");
        std::printf("%s\n",
            "------  ------------------------------  ----------  ------  ------  -----  -----");

        for (const auto& fi : funcs) {
            const char marker = (fi.index == global) ? '*' : ' ';

            char flags[32] = "";
            if (fi.isStrictMode) strncat(flags, "strict ", sizeof(flags) - strlen(flags) - 1);
            if (fi.isAsync)      strncat(flags, "async ",  sizeof(flags) - strlen(flags) - 1);
            if (fi.isGenerator)  strncat(flags, "gen ",    sizeof(flags) - strlen(flags) - 1);

            std::printf("[%3u]%c  %-30s  0x%08X  %6u  %6u  %5u  %s\n",
                fi.index,
                marker,
                fi.name.c_str(),
                fi.offset,
                fi.bytecodeSizeInBytes,
                fi.paramCount,
                fi.frameSize,
                flags);
        }

        std::printf("\n[*] = global function (entry point)\n");

    } catch (const std::exception& e) {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "Error: %s\n", e.what());
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }
    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
}
```

`tools/hbc-patch.cpp`:

```cpp
// hbc_patch <input.hbc> --offset <hex> --value <hex> -o <output.hbc>
//
// Overwrites a single byte of an HBC file. It does NOT update the SHA-1
// footer on purpose: the Hermes runtime doesn't verify it, which is how that
// was established. Structural edits go through `Module`, which recomputes it.

#include "hbc/hbc.h"
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <fstream>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <string>

int main(int argc, char* argv[]) {
    if (argc != 8) {
        std::fprintf(stderr,
            "Usage: hbc_patch <input.hbc> --offset <hex> --value <hex> -o <output.hbc>\n");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    const char* input_path  = argv[1];
    uint32_t    offset      = static_cast<uint32_t>(std::stoul(argv[3], nullptr, 0));
    uint8_t     value       = static_cast<uint8_t> (std::stoul(argv[5], nullptr, 0));
    const char* output_path = argv[7];

    try {
        hbc::HBCFile f = hbc::HBCFile::open(input_path);
        auto bytes = f.serialize();

        if (offset >= bytes.size())
            throw std::out_of_range("offset 0x" + std::to_string(offset) +
                                    " is beyond file size " + std::to_string(bytes.size()));

        uint8_t old_value = bytes[offset];
        bytes[offset] = value;
        std::printf("Patched offset 0x%08X: 0x%02X -> 0x%02X\n", offset, old_value, value);

        std::ofstream out(output_path, std::ios::binary);
        out.write(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(bytes.data()), bytes.size());
        std::printf("Written %zu bytes to %s\n", bytes.size(), output_path);
    } catch (const std::exception& e) {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "Error: %s\n", e.what());
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }
    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
}
```

```cpp
// hbc_roundtrip <input.hbc> <output.hbc>: parses and re-serializes a file.
// The output must be byte-identical to the input (check with `cmp`).

#include "hbc/hbc.h"
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <exception>
#include <fstream>
#include <ios>

int main(int argc, char* argv[]) {
    if (argc != 3) {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "Usage: hbc_roundtrip <input.hbc> <output.hbc>\n");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }
    try {
        hbc::HBCFile f = hbc::HBCFile::open(argv[1]);
        auto bytes = f.serialize();

        std::ofstream out(argv[2], std::ios::binary);
        out.write(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(bytes.data()), bytes.size());

        std::printf("Written %zu bytes to %s\n", bytes.size(), argv[2]);
    } catch (const std::exception& e) {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "Error: %s\n", e.what());
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }
    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
}
```

`tools/hbc-section-map.cpp`:

```cpp
// hbc_section_map <file.hbc>: every section with offset, size and alignment,
// then checks that the sections cover the whole file with no gap.

#include "hbc/hbc.h"
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <exception>
#include <string>

int main(int argc, char* argv[]) {
    if (argc != 2) {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "Usage: hbc_section_map <file.hbc>\n");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }
    try {
        hbc::HBCFile f = hbc::HBCFile::open(argv[1]);
        auto smap = f.section_map();
        const auto& h = f.header();

        std::printf("%-28s  %10s  %8s  %5s\n", "section", "offset", "size", "align");
        std::printf("%s\n", std::string(57, '-').c_str());

        for (const auto& s : smap) {
            std::printf("%-28s  0x%08X  %8u  %5u\n",
                s.name.c_str(), s.offset, s.size, s.align);
        }

        std::printf("%s\n", std::string(57, '-').c_str());
        std::printf("fileLength (from header): %u\n", h.fileLength);

        const auto& last = smap.back();
        std::printf("last section end:         %u\n", last.offset + last.size);

        if (last.offset + last.size == h.fileLength)
            std::printf("Coverage: OK (sections cover the whole file)\n");
        else
            std::printf("Coverage: GAP of %d bytes\n",
                        (int)h.fileLength - (int)(last.offset + last.size));

    } catch (const std::exception& e) {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "Error: %s\n", e.what());
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }
    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
}
```

`tools/hbc-strings.cpp`:

```cpp
// hbc_strings <file.hbc>: every string with its kind from the String Kind
// Table: [string] is a runtime literal, [identifier] a property/method name.

#include "hbc/hbc.h"
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>

int main(int argc, char* argv[]) {
    if (argc != 2) {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "Usage: hbc-strings <file.hbc>\n");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }
    try {
        hbc::HBCFile f = hbc::HBCFile::open(argv[1]);
        const auto& strings = f.strings();
        const auto& kinds   = f.stringKinds();

        std::printf("String count: %zu\n\n", strings.size());

        for (size_t i = 0; i < strings.size(); ++i) {
            const char* kindLabel =
                (kinds[i] == hbc::StringKind::Identifier) ? "identifier" : "string";

            // Quote first, then pad, so the padding falls outside the quotes.
            std::string quoted = "\"" + strings[i] + "\"";
            std::printf("[%4zu] %-24s [%s]\n", i, quoted.c_str(), kindLabel);
        }
    } catch (const std::exception& e) {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "Error: %s\n", e.what());
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }
    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
}
```

`tools/inspect_real_bundle.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Inspect real-app HBC bundles for the structural features the patcher tests need.

Run:
    export PYTHONPATH=build/bindings:$PYTHONPATH
    .venv/bin/python tools/inspect_real_bundle.py seeder/real-apps/*.hbc

For each bundle it reports: version, #functions, #strings; shared-body groups
(the resize-shared test); overflow function headers; functions with an exception
handler (the EH-relocation test); UTF-16 and overflow string entries. It also
prints concrete candidate indices to use as test targets.
"""
import os
import sys
from collections import defaultdict

import _libhbc


def inspect(path):
    hbc = _libhbc.HBCFile.open(path)
    funcs = list(hbc.functions())
    strings = list(hbc.string_entries())
    version = hbc.version()

    # shared bodies: same (offset, size)
    groups = defaultdict(list)
    for i, f in enumerate(funcs):
        groups[(f.offset, f.bytecodeSizeInBytes)].append(i)
    shared_groups = {k: v for k, v in groups.items() if len(v) > 1}
    shared_members = sum(len(v) for v in shared_groups.values())

    overflow_funcs = [i for i, f in enumerate(funcs) if f.overflowed]
    eh_funcs = [i for i, f in enumerate(funcs) if f.hasExceptionHandler]
    eh_single = [i for i in eh_funcs if not funcs[i].shared]

    utf16 = [j for j, s in enumerate(strings) if s.is_utf16]
    ovf_str = [j for j, s in enumerate(strings) if s.is_overflow]

    # a shared group to use as a test target (the smallest body)
    sample_group = None
    if shared_groups:
        (off, size), members = min(shared_groups.items(), key=lambda kv: kv[0][1])
        sample_group = (off, size, members[:6])

    print(f"\n=== {os.path.basename(path)} ===")
    print(f"  version            : {version}")
    print(f"  functions          : {len(funcs)}")
    print(f"  strings            : {len(strings)}")
    print(f"  shared-body groups : {len(shared_groups)}  "
          f"({shared_members} funcs, {100*shared_members//max(1,len(funcs))}%)")
    if sample_group:
        off, size, members = sample_group
        print(f"    sample group     : off={off:#x} size={size} members={members}")
    print(f"  overflow functions : {len(overflow_funcs)}"
          + (f"  e.g. {overflow_funcs[:5]}" if overflow_funcs else ""))
    print(f"  funcs with EH      : {len(eh_funcs)}"
          + (f"  (non-shared e.g. {eh_single[:5]})" if eh_single else "  (none non-shared!)"))
    print(f"  UTF-16 strings     : {len(utf16)}"
          + (f"  e.g. {utf16[:5]}" if utf16 else ""))
    print(f"  overflow strings   : {len(ovf_str)}"
          + (f"  e.g. {ovf_str[:5]}" if ovf_str else ""))

    # EH-resize target: a non-shared function with a non-empty EH table
    for i in eh_single:
        ehs = list(funcs[i].exceptionHandlers)
        if ehs:
            print(f"  EH-resize target   : func {i}  "
                  f"EH={[(e.start, e.end, e.target) for e in ehs][:3]}")
            break


if __name__ == "__main__":
    paths = sys.argv[1:]
    if not paths:
        print(__doc__)
        sys.exit(2)
    for p in paths:
        try:
            inspect(p)
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"\n=== {os.path.basename(p)} ===\n  ERROR: {e}")
```
